ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (dark) pixels; approximately 95:5 ratio of dark background to high-intensity white focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark surface mapping across the 2D fluke plane, interspersed with discrete, high-contrast white circular and annular (ring-shaped) clusters ranging in diameter from 5 to 15 pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression; calculated angle at vertex is approximately 45 degrees, with a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile; left lobe contains roughly 10-12 identifiable low-amplitude peaks; right lobe features larger, irregular protrusions and a distinct brownish-textured accumulation at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve is primarily convex from the median notch to the distal tips, with localized irregularities near the terminal edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings) distributed across both lobes, with higher density observed on the mid-to-outer regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least two distinct, thin linear pixel disruptions visible: one on the right lobe extending toward the upper trailing edge and a shorter vertical mark on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, brownish-white irregular growth or accumulation on the distal tip of the right lobe; extensive circular scarring across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density and distribution of white annular scars against an otherwise uniform dark pigmentation.
